Puerto Princesa (port locode PHPPS) is a city in western Palawan Island (Philippines), with population around 260,000. Puerto Princesa is among the Philippines' 38 independent cities that are not controlled by the province to which they belong.

Currently, Puerto Princesa is a famous tourist location (known as the Philippines' Eco-Tourism Center) offering numerous seafood restaurants, beach resorts, hotels (basic to 5-star premium), bars, and shops (including large shopping malls).

Most travellers come to see Puerto Princesa Subterranean River National Park, located approx 50 km (30 ml) north of the city. The city is also the gateway for tours to Tubbataha Reef.

Port Puerto Princesa serves domestic passenger ferries to Coron (Busuanga Island), Iloilo (Visayan Island) and Manila (Luzon Island).
